title: Market priming checklist and metrics slate
content:
Purpose:
This doc collects the launch-readiness checklist, KPI slate, and short-run monitoring plan for the Market Priming initiative (first external rollout of lightweight RBAC + routing policy). Intended as the single reference for product-ops, growth, SRE, and ENG owners during the two-week activation window.

Scope and non-goals:
- Includes pre-flight gating, day-of operational checks, and 72-hour post-activation monitoring.
- Focused on systems and signals (latency, error budgets, onboarding conversion). Not a campaign plan (marketing owns campaign creative).
- Non-goal: full post-mortem template (we'll fork standard PM postmortem).

High-level timeline (milestone anchors):
- M-14: Final go/no-go sync (product, eng, SRE, growth)
- M-7: Canary rollout to 5% traffic in dedicated region (EU-west)
- M-3: Decision to expand to 25% or rollback based on KPI window
- M+0: Full activation to tiered customers (as defined in PDP)
- M+3 days: Critical review and decide any immediate mitigations

Owners and escalation path:
- Product Ops lead: Maya Rodriguez (owner of this doc)
- Engineering owner: Ethan Park (serving runtime)
- SRE lead: Lena Müller (on-call 24h through M+3)
- Growth/product marketing liaison: Samir Desai
- Exec escalation: VP Product (email + slack #exec-alerts)

KPI slate (primary + secondary; targets are conservative for initial rollout):
Primary metrics (must meet thresholds for expansion):
- p95 inference latency (hosted route): target <= 220ms; alert if > 300ms for 30m window
- error rate (5xx + 429 combined): target <= 0.6%; alert if > 1.5% sustained 15m
- end-to-end success rate (request -> final token produced): >= 99.2%
- activation onboarding conversion (trial->activated within 7 days): baseline 8%, target uplift +3pp

Secondary metrics (monitor, not blocking):
- cost per 1k tokens for active routes: baseline $0.78; expected +/-10% during canary
- token throughput (requests/min peak): ensure capacity headroom >= 40%
- model quality regressions (A/B prompt set): BLEU-like pass-rate >= 95% on smoke set

Acceptance gating checklist (M-1 pre-flight):
- [ ] All release notes and customer-facing docs drafted and posted to support portal
- [ ] Runbook updated in SRE handbook with rollback steps and contact list
- [ ] Canary config defined (traffic routing policy, quota caps, circuit-breakers)
- [ ] Alerting thresholds set in NewRelic/Datadog and sanity dashboards created
- [ ] End-to-end test suite green on staging for 48h (including auth flows)
- [ ] Security review sign-off (compliance ok for initial cohort)
- [ ] Billing & usage limits validated with finance for trial customers

Day-of activation checklist (hourly cadence first 6 hours):
- T-0: Flip routing rule to canary (5%); confirm config via infra audit log (owner: Ethan)
- 0-30m: Validate p50/p95 latencies on the canary cohort; check success rate on smoke prompts
- 30-90m: Monitor customer-facing logs for new error patterns; check support channel for spikes
- 90-180m: Decision gate (continue expansion / hold / rollback) based on primary KPI thresholds
- 180-24h: If expanding, increment to 25%; repeat the 3-hour decision cadence

Rollback criteria (any of these triggers immediate rollback to previous routing policy):
- p95 > 350ms for 30 minutes and trending worse
- error rate > 3% sustained 15m OR any repeating critical exception (NPE, OOM)
- customer-reported data correctness issue affecting >2 customers in first 24h

Monitoring dashboards and signal definition notes:
- Dashboard 1: Activation health (latency, error rate, throughput, replica CPU/GPU utilizations)
- Dashboard 2: Customer impact (per-customer success rates, support mentions, chat volume)
- Dashboard 3: Cost-tracking (per-model token cost, infra spend delta during canary)
- Signal notes: "success rate" = final token produced without retriable server-side failure.

Comm plan (short form):
- Pre-flight: Slack #product-ops with summary + link to doc; schedule 30m preflight call M-1
- Day-of: #activation-live channel for real-time updates (SRE posts every hour), product-ops to post decision recs
- Post-activation: 24h + 72h summary in Confluence; growth to prepare initial customer outreach script if expansion successful

Post-launch 72-hour runbook and checkpoints:
- 0-24h: live monitoring; SRE tails logs and triages; product manager collects qualitative feedback from first cohort
- 24-48h: trend review vs baseline (latency, errors, cost); finance notified if spend delta > 12%
- 48-72h: final decision on permanent rollout cadence or need for mitigations; prepare rollout backlog items if quality regressions found

Unresolved items / TODOs (notes to self):
- [ ] Need a quick internal survey template for customers in the canary cohort (Samir)
- [ ] Confirm whether dedicated capacity autoscaler will trigger additional instances at 25% — Ethan to validate with infra
- [ ] Confirm tagging for telemetry to separate canary cohort in metrics pipeline (Lena)

Risk register (top 3 risks and mitigations):
1) Unexpected latency spike due to kernel selection mismatch. Mitigation: pin to previous kernel and route to fallback variant; SRE on-call to trigger.
2) Cost overshoot from heavier tokenization patterns in real-world prompts. Mitigation: temporary quota throttles + optimize batching settings in Redwood Optimize.
3) Customer confusion from staggered rollout. Mitigation: clear messaging via support portal + proactive emails to pilot customers.

Quick links (operational):
- Runbook (SRE): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SRE/Activation+Runbook
- Canary routing config: infra repo -> /deploy/canary-configs/market-priming.yaml
- Support playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Market+Priming+Playbook

Notes and retrospective anchors:
- Capture the 0-6 hour logs and anonymized prompt samples for model quality review.
- Use the standard postmortem template regardless of outcome; aim to have first draft within 7 days.

Appendix (short-form checkboxes for final sign-off):
- [ ] Product Ops has approval from Growth and ENG
- [ ] SRE sign-off on monitoring and rollback
- [ ] Finance ack for spend guardrails
- [ ] Security/compliance review completed

End of doc.

(Version note: this is a working doc — expect minor edits; please ping Maya with any suggested changes or missing signals.)
